g.text: Graceful failure: step down one rung, do not fall off
when unsure, move to a safer rung; the rest of the product keeps working
answer, with confidence that matches accuracy
show sources; let the user edit, reject, undo
below a threshold: retry or rephrase
fall back to a rule-based or manual path
say "I don't know" or hand off to a human
kill switch: roll back the model or prompt
a wrong answer with no way out is what users do not forgive
trust is built in four layers
